answer: To resist Sybil attacks, the economy enforces a progressive proof-of-burn mechanism where minting identities requires irreversible cryptographic stake burning. An attacker minting n identities incurs a superlinear cost scaling as O(n^2), rendering bulk spoofing economically unviable. Like filtering a copper coin from a rushing river, the protocol verifies authentic value transfers; hollow fake agents cannot sustain the exponential capital depletion.
